settings.content: The palette is fixed monochrome by design — colour comes only from product photography. To change it, edit the token block at the top of assets/noctairre.css.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: 512×512 PNG. Falls back to the 夜 mark.

settings.label: Social share image
settings.info: 1200×630. Used when a link is shared.

settings.label: Drifting petals
settings.info: Desktop only. Automatically disabled on mobile and for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Petal colour
settings.info: The one place colour is allowed on the site. #F7B9CE is sakura pink; #E8A0BC is deeper; #F4F2ED returns them to bone white.

settings.label: Petal count
settings.info: Higher is heavier on older laptops. 26 reads as drifting; above 40 starts to feel like weather.

settings.label: 夜 intro animation
settings.info: Shown once per visit. Turn off if you want the fastest possible first impression.
